io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.hosting: EU data center in Navarra (Spain), own hardware, no third-party AI subprocessors

lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/chatgpt: ChatGPT connector lane: curated tool set for business documents and knowledge base articles, every tool listed individually (no discovery meta-tools). Alias: /openai.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/claude: Anthropic Directory lane (Claude Desktop, claude.ai): business documents, no TTS.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/cursor: Same catalog as /dms, tuned for Cursor and Windsurf. Also shipped as the paperoffice Cursor Marketplace plugin.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/dms: Canonical Documents Operations catalog (14 tools + discovery). Default for generic MCP clients such as Claude Code, VS Code, Cline.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/grok: Grok connector lane: the curated /chatgpt tools, every tool listed individually, without the ChatGPT-only attachment upload.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/mcp-full: Complete surface, 300+ API/MCP tools, for power users and agents.
lanes.https://mcp.paperoffice.ai/muse: Meta Muse connector lane: the same curated tools as /grok.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.stdio_package: npx -y @paperoffice-ai/mcp — dependency-free stdio bridge to the same remote lanes for clients without remote MCP support. Token in PAPEROFFICE_API_KEY.
